source.description: A compact citation card for a book, article, or other source: type badge, title, author/year, status, and an optional progress bar.

attributes.name: data
attributes.description: A bound progress value: a number, or an object with a progress or value field.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The source's title. Without one the card is headed Untitled source.

attributes.name: year
attributes.description: Shown in the byline, next to the author.

attributes.name: url
attributes.description: A safe http or https URL, which turns the title into a link.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The kind of source. An unrecognized value shows as a neutral badge carrying that text.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Where the source stands. Anything else is omitted rather than guessed at.

attributes.name: progress
attributes.description: Percent read, 0 to 100. Wins over the pages pair and over the binding.

attributes.name: pages-read
attributes.description: Pages read so far. With pages, it becomes the progress bar.

attributes.name: pages
attributes.description: The total page count. With pages-read, it becomes the progress bar.

quote.description: A cited passage: the quoted markdown, a right-aligned citation line, and an optional commentary line.

attributes.name: source
attributes.description: A short citation, such as a title or an author.

attributes.name: page
attributes.description: A page number, rendered as p. 152.

attributes.name: loc
attributes.description: An ebook location, rendered as loc. 240.

attributes.name: at
attributes.description: A timestamp such as 12:34, rendered as given.

attributes.name: note
attributes.description: A short commentary line under the citation.

term.description: An inline term with an optional tooltip and keyboard-focusable definition.

attributes.name: def
attributes.description: The definition, shown as a tooltip and a focus-reachable panel.

at.description: A monospace timestamp or page chip, optionally linked to a source with that position appended to the URL.

attributes.name: href
attributes.description: A link target. A safe http or https URL gets the timestamp or page appended.

mark.description: A highlighter-style inline marker, tinted by kind: insight, question, disagree, or todo.

attributes.name: kind
attributes.description: The tint of the highlight. A missing or unrecognized value falls back to neutral.
